concerns.text: FR-006 mandates packaging the pipeline in a reproducible Docker container, but no task in Phases 9–11 (and none cited from T001–T065) creates or verifies a Dockerfile; plan.md's Project Structure also lists none. Add a task producing and smoke-testing the container, or record a plan-level decision dropping it.

Constitution Principle VII requires effect sizes (AUC-ROC, precision-recall, R²) to be accompanied by 95% confidence intervals, but no Phase 9–11 task computes CIs and neither output schema defines per-effect-size CI fields (output.schema.yaml has only a single performance-level confidence_interval). Add a CI-computation task and schema fields.

T066 introduces halt code EX_RESOURCE_LIMIT (04), which appears in no FR in spec.md and no plan.md decision note — a stale/unanchored requirement reference. Either add an FR authorizing it or trace it to a recorded plan decision.

T073 requires outputs to validate against both model_output.schema.yaml and output.schema.yaml, which use conflicting field names for the same quantities (cv_score/null_baseline_score vs cv_accuracy/baseline_accuracy); no task reconciles them, so a task could satisfy one schema and fail the other. Add a reconciliation task or specify which file targets which schema.
